items.source:
Create a new instance passing in the common pieces that will be shared if multiple
EntityManagerFactory instances are created.
items.translation: 创建新实例时，传入如果创建了多个 EntityManagerFactory 实例将共享的公共部分。

items.source: Create a new EntityManagerFactoryBuilder.Builder for a EntityManagerFactory using the settings of the given instance, and the given DataSource.
items.translation: 为给定的实例设置和给定的DataSource创建一个用于EntityManagerFactory的新EntityManagerFactoryBuilder.Builder。

items.source: jpaPropertiesFactory - the JPA properties to be passed to the persistence provider, based on the configured data source
items.translation: jpaPropertiesFactory - 基于配置的数据源传递给持久化提供程序的 JPA 属性。

items.source: persistenceUnitManager - optional source of persistence unit information (can be null)
items.translation: - 可选的持久化单元信息源（可为 null）

items.source: Convenient builder for JPA EntityManagerFactory instances. Collects common configuration when constructed and then allows you to create one or more LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean through a fluent builder pattern. The most common options are covered in the builder, but you can always manipulate the product of the builder if you need more control, before returning it from a @Bean definition.
items.translation: JPA EntityManagerFactory 实例的便捷构建器。在构造时收集通用配置，然后通过流式构建模式创建一个或多个LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean。构建器涵盖了最常见的选项，但如果您需要更多控制，可以在从@Bean定义返回之前始终操纵构建器的产物。

items.source: Set the persistence unit post processors to be applied to the PersistenceUnitInfo used for creating the LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean.
items.translation: 将 persistence unit post processors 设置为应用于用于创建 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 的 PersistenceUnitInfo。

items.source: Configure the bootstrap executor to be used by the LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean.
items.translation: 配置用于由 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 使用的 bootstrap 执行器。

items.source: persistenceUnitRootLocation - the persistence unit root location to use as a fallback or null
items.translation: persistenceUnitRootLocation - 用作回退的持久化单元根位置或null
用于创建 `EntityManagerFactory` 的构建器。

items.source: persistenceUnitPostProcessors - the persistence unit post processors to use
items.translation: <persistenceUnitPostProcessors> - 要使用的持久化单元后置处理器

items.source: A fluent builder for a LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean.
Dave Syer, Phillip Webb, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Dave Syer, Phillip Webb, Stephane Nicoll
